text: にんげんを　のせて　みずの　うえ　はしる　ポケモン　みたこと　ある　アルよ！

structure.jp: にんげんを　のせて
みずの　うえ　はしる　ポケモン
structure.en: a Pokémon that runs over the water

structure.jp: みたこと　ある　アルよ！

patterns.name: 〜たことがある
patterns.explanation: A past verb followed by ことがある means having done it at least once; the が is dropped here in casual talk. みたこと ある = 'I have seen it before'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: にんげんを　のせて　みずの　うえ　はしる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing describes that thing. にんげんを のせて みずの うえ はしる ポケモン = 'a Pokémon that runs across the water carrying people'.

patterns.name: 〜アル
patterns.explanation: アル tacked on the end of a sentence is a made-up accent that Japanese fiction gives to Chinese characters; it adds no meaning. みたこと ある アルよ = 'I have seen one!'
